items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: A very famous guy was the coach, Johnny Brechtel, who was really a good coach.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I went to Warren Easton in 1937 to 41. And in 1936, the year before I went to Warren Easton, in the regular season, the football team was undefeated, untied, and unscored on. Of course they went up to Baton Rouge and got beat by a Strumahe, bumped your big farmers, plowed up the field with them. But you know, those were days when Warren Easton had a fantastic athletic program. A very famous guy was the coach, Johnny Brechtel, who was really a good coach. He'd have been a professional coach by today's…
It was fun. So how'd you get into Warren Easton at such a young age?
